svg.title: Source implementation: 34 of 46 named checkpoints landed; 12 open, including F08 in progress with 3 of 6 child steps landed.
svg.desc: Six workstream cards list every parent checkpoint by name and stable ID. A check means landed source, an arrow means in progress, and a dash means open. Each bar has one segment per listed checkpoint, in list order. Evidence handoff: 10 of 10 landed. Historical recovery: 4 of 5 landed. Permissions and grants: 10 of 10 landed. Finalization and sessions: 7 of 8 landed. Workloads and native: 3 of 6 landed. Providers and operations: 0 of 7 landed. An expanded F08 bar names all six child steps: F08.1 retained finalization admission, F08.2 original assertion/CAS derivation and F08.3 existing login hardening are landed; F08.4 protected activation/token delivery is in progress; F08.5 public activation/recovery and F08.6 integrated portal flow remain open. Inside F08.4, a read proofs, b encrypted originals and c business effects are landed; d protected planning is in progress; e custody/execution is open. Planning details d.1 capacity adapter, d.2 signed-original mechanics, d.3 indexed writes and d.4 configured owner/private retention are landed; d.5 cold admission is in progress: root-authenticated configuration, key delivery and the private planner service are landed, but independently fresh latest-head admission remains open. Root-signed launch snapshots do not supply that freshness. Action-time one-use execution remains in e. F08 remains unchecked at 3 of 6 child steps. All eight F07 completion and recovery substeps are landed within that parent. Child steps are not additional parent checkpoints. These are tracked source-integration counts, not whole-product or effort percentages. Source remains unbuilt, unexecuted and unprovisioned. Independent production acceptance remains 0 of 6 verified gates.
